title: Zero fan-out characterizes the output
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit in which every gate has distinct arguments and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate, and exactly two otherwise. Suppose every vertex other than the output has positive fan-out. For every vertex $v$ below the size of $C$, $v$ has fan-out zero if and only if $v$ is the output.
